title: Injection of Dorsal Scapular n at Different Levels, Dose it Make Difference?
brief_summary: Dorsal scapular nerve (DSN) entrapment syndrome is an under-recognized cause of neck and shoulder pain. DSN injuries can be the origin of a well-defined chronic pain syndrome, often referred to as DSN syndrome. DSN syndrome is often characterized by a dull ache along the medial border of the scapula.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* scapular pain

Exclusion Criteria:

* cervical radiculopathy
